fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2008, for every one-cent change in the cost per gallon of jet fuel, Hawaiian's annual fuel expense will increase or decrease by approximately $1.3 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: Effective Aug 2007, switched from jet fuel OTC forwards to NYMEX heating oil futures (phasing out jet fuel forwards). Heating oil futures FV=$3.3M at Dec 31 2007 (not SFAS 133 derivatives). Jet fuel forwards FV=$0.4M at Dec 31 2007 (~2% of 2008 needs). As of Feb 22, 2008: heating oil Q1 9,156k gal (28%), Q2 6,090k gal (19%), Q3 3,192k gal (10%); jet fuel Q1 714k gal (2%). Total ~19.152M gallons hedged for 2008.

warnings: Volume table reflects positions as of Feb 22, 2008; heating oil futures excluded from SFAS 133 derivative accounting; total FV combines jet fuel forwards ($0.4M) and heating oil futures ($3.3M)
